title: Bind existing Daily Director confidence to prospective outcome lineage
objective: Implement the smallest research-only immutable confidence-binding sidecar for future valid Daily Director outputs so existing LOW/MEDIUM/HIGH header labels can later be calibrated against causally linked matured outcomes without historical prose backfill or automatic tuning.
primary_target: scripts/api_agent/directly related Daily Director confidence binding helper
allowed_change_scope: scripts/api_agent/directly related Daily Director confidence binding/materialization helper
research/api_agent/directly related immutable confidence binding root or pointer
.github/workflows/daily-director-shadow.yml only if required to call the existing bounded helper without changing prompt semantics or API budget

evidence.summary: Current prompt requires machine-readable CYCLE_HEADER with CONFIDENCE=LOW|MEDIUM|HIGH.
Forecast contract preserves target and source semantics but does not bind confidence as a forecast field.
Representative frozen forecast contains target/source lineage but no confidence label.

reproduction: On fresh main, confirm Daily Director prompt requires structured confidence, then inspect forecast candidate/frozen forecast artifacts and confirm confidence is not causally bound to output hash and eventual outcome lineage. Historical prose extraction is not an admissible substitute.

positive: A valid future Daily Director output with one CYCLE_HEADER produces exactly one immutable binding containing output/receipt hashes, frozen header fields and exact emitted candidate IDs.
A later read-only calibration can join only causally linked matured non-censored outcomes to the frozen confidence bucket and reports sample counts.
negative: Missing or malformed CYCLE_HEADER fails closed as CONFIDENCE_BINDING_UNAVAILABLE and is not inferred from summary/rationale prose.
No historical prose backfill, prompt tuning, confidence threshold changes, model changes, market-rule changes or automatic portfolio actions occur.
